weapons.name: Astra Style-6
weapons.Note: Ubiquitous Spanish polymer holdout firing 5mm fragmenting plastic rounds.

weapons.name: BudgetArms C-13
weapons.Note: Light-duty holdout commonly sold as a 'lady's gun.'

weapons.name: Dai Lung Cybermag 15
weapons.Note: Cheap Hong Kong knockoff often carried by boosters and other street trash.

weapons.name: Federated Arms Impact
weapons.Note: Ten-shot low-caliber pistol with unusually good reliability.

weapons.name: Federated Arms X-22
weapons.Note: Polymer one-shot sold in 13 colors. The 6mm model costs 50-150eb; a .22 caseless version deals 1D6 damage and costs 25-50eb.

weapons.name: Federated Arms X-38
weapons.Note: Inexpensive .38 caseless automatic.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-12 Police Pistol
weapons.Note: Standard Japanese police sidearm. A smartgun version provides WA +5 and costs 810eb.

weapons.name: Arasaka WSA Autopistol
weapons.Note: Standard sidearm for Arasaka troops and executives.

weapons.name: BudgetArms C-41
weapons.Note: Ten-shot high-caliber pistol with good reliability.

weapons.name: BudgetArms Laser-Niner
weapons.Note: Integral laser sight. J/15/3 in standard configuration; L/35/20 with the assault clip loaded.

weapons.name: Beretta M97P
weapons.Note: Integral laser sight. Uses plastic-cased ammunition.

weapons.name: CCMMC Goaxing Xiuxi CM-3
weapons.Note: The most powerful handgun civilians may legally own in mainland China; unavailable elsewhere.

weapons.name: Colt Alpha-Omega Competition Pistol (.45 ACP)
weapons.Note: May be ordered with a Nikon COT sight system for an additional 3900eb.

weapons.name: Colt Alpha-Omega Competition Pistol (10mm)
weapons.Note: May be ordered with a Nikon COT sight system for an additional 3900eb.

weapons.name: Colt Enforcement 10 Sidearm (Basic)
weapons.Note: Smartchipping adds 550eb.

weapons.name: Colt Enforcement 10 Sidearm (Camouflaged)
weapons.Note: Smartchipping adds 550eb.

weapons.name: Dai Lung Streetmaster
weapons.Note: Another Dai Lung cheapie, built for the Street.

weapons.name: FN Browning "3-Spot" Machine Pistol
weapons.Note: Fires a three-round burst with each pull of the trigger.

weapons.name: Federated Arms X-9mm
weapons.Note: Sturdy sidearm used by state militias in the United States.

weapons.name: Fashion Gun 9
weapons.Note: Listed price range is 35-40eb. Emptying the magazine causes the barrel shroud to melt and permanently jam the weapon.

weapons.name: Goncz-Taurus Pistol
weapons.Note: Listed price range is 200-275eb. Selective-fire version is a separate entry.

weapons.name: Goncz-Taurus Pistol (Selective-Fire)
weapons.Note: Listed price range is 300-400eb. Accepts 15- or 30-round magazines; ROF 2/10.

weapons.name: Glock Thirty Machine Pistol
weapons.Note: Selective single-shot or three-round burst. Can use the standard 20-round pistol magazine or the 30-round magazine.

weapons.name: Hammer M-11 Bolt Pistol
weapons.Note: Armor is treated as x1/4; damage after penetration is x1/2. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: IMI Gamad
weapons.Note: Accuracy is +1 with the lasersight. A smartgun variant is available. Extended 15-round magazine costs 35eb and raises concealment to J.

weapons.name: Kang Tao Type 97
weapons.Note: Compact polymer service pistol from Kang Tao.

weapons.name: LeRoi Maxi-10
weapons.Note: High-capacity 10mm pistol aimed at the professional security market.

weapons.name: Militech Arms Avenger
weapons.Note: Militech's reliable standard heavy-caliber sidearm.

weapons.name: Militech Black Widow Flechette Pistol
weapons.Note: Each shell contains 10 flechettes with a one-meter spread at medium range. Each hit inflicts 1/2D6; armor is halved. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Militech Silver Shadow Flechette Pistol
weapons.Note: Each shell contains 6 flechettes with a half-meter spread at medium range. Each hit inflicts 1D6/3; armor is halved. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nomad .357 Magnum Autoloader
weapons.Note: Standard hot loads inflict 3D6+1. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nomad .357 Magnum Revolver
weapons.Note: Includes three two-round half-moon clips. Standard hot loads inflict 3D6+1. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Sci Fi Starrior 4
weapons.Note: Flashy four-shot pistol designed for style-conscious buyers.

weapons.name: Stein & Wasserman "Tri-Star" Revolver
weapons.Note: Fires .410 shotgun ammunition, including standard shotshells, slugs and proprietary Tri-Plex loads. Integral sight projects a red aiming dot and spread circle.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer P-41 Autoloading Pistol
weapons.Note: Reliable European autoloading service pistol.

weapons.name: Stolbovoy St-2 Pistol
weapons.Note: Common in the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe; rare in the U.S. On FNFF reliability tables, Stolbovoy weapons jam only on a roll of 1. Smartchipped version costs 850eb.

weapons.name: Surprising Stranger
weapons.Note: Listed price range is 15-50eb. Four-shot pepperbox design; muzzle-loaded at one round per combat turn.

weapons.name: Teen Dreem
weapons.Note: Full-auto capable. Has a 60% chance to melt under full autofire.

weapons.name: Texas Arms Model-351 Gyrojet Pistol
weapons.Note: Common on Luna but rarely seen Earth-side.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-13 Police Pistol
weapons.Note: Smartgun system available to pistol officers for 800eb, WA +4.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-14 Pistol
weapons.Note: Standard model has three-round burst or full-auto. Officer version includes a smartgun system, WA +4, and costs 820eb.

weapons.name: Tsunami Express Racegun
weapons.Note: Competition electrothermal pistol with an integral Zeiss-Nikon COT sight. Ammunition costs 50eb per 50 and the 50-shot battery costs 10eb. A 125eb replacement grip changes concealment to J and WA to +2; the barrel compensator prevents suppression.

weapons.name: Wondernines
weapons.Note: Generic modern 9mm caseless service pistols. Capacity is 14+1D6 rounds and price is 240eb plus 10eb times the same die result.

weapons.name: BudgetArms Auto-3
weapons.Note: On a fumble or jam, there is a 10% chance the weapon explodes, inflicting 2D6 damage to the firer's arm.

weapons.name: Dai Lung Magnum
weapons.Note: If the weapon jams or is fumbled, it has a 60% chance of injuring the firer for 2D6+1 damage to the arm.

weapons.name: Espinoza One Shot
weapons.Note: On a misfire or jam, there is a 60% chance the weapon explodes and inflicts 2D6+1 damage.

weapons.name: Malorian Arms Heavy Flechette Pistol
weapons.Note: Armor is treated as x1/4, but damage is normal. Requires the owner's safety-chipped wristband or wrist socket. Disposable magazines cost 14eb.

weapons.name: Mustang Arms "Mark II"
weapons.Note: Uses a 12-round magazine or a larger 20-round magazine. Reliability drops to ST after more than one day without cleaning in a dirty environment, and drops one level for every 24 rounds fired without cleaning.

weapons.name: Nova Model 338 Citygun
weapons.Note: Uses disposable seven-round Ammo Cassettes. Empty cassettes cost 5eb, boxed ammunition costs 15eb, and preloaded cassettes cost 7eb.

weapons.name: Nova Model 757 Cityhunter
weapons.Note: Revolver-like autoloader with an integral laser sight. The cylinder can be topped off one round at a time or replaced as a complete disposable tube.

weapons.name: Stein & Wasserman Bi-Power Handcannon (.44 Magnum)
weapons.Note: One of the Bi-Power's two barrels. The complete weapon is concealment L for users with BOD below 8.

weapons.name: Stein & Wasserman Bi-Power Handcannon (.45 ACP)
weapons.Note: One of the Bi-Power's two barrels. The complete weapon is concealment L for users with BOD below 8.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer P-35
weapons.Note: Heavy European police and military autoloader.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms "Raimei" Ramjet Pistol
weapons.Note: Smartchipped price. COT variant costs 3200eb. Damage is 5D6 at Close range, 6D6+3 at Medium, 7D6 at Long, and 7D6+1 at Extreme. Armor SP is x3 and penetrating damage is doubled because of the lower-point ramjet round.

weapons.name: 454 Magnum Disposable
weapons.Note: Non-reloadable over-under holdout. Pulling the tab activates its permanently sealed battery.

weapons.name: Ameritech Magnum
weapons.Note: Large-frame magnum autoloader built for the American market.

weapons.name: Armalite 44
weapons.Note: Standard very-heavy handgun from the Cyberpunk 2020 Corebook.

weapons.name: Colt AMT Model 2000
weapons.Note: Large, powerful autoloader chambered for 12mm caseless ammunition.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Multi-Ammunition Pistol
weapons.Note: Revolver using proprietary cased ammunition. Its selector permits lethal and non-lethal rounds to be chosen before firing.

weapons.name: Federated Arms 454 DA "Super Chief"
weapons.Note: Double-action revolver using cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Malorian Arms 3516
weapons.Note: Custom weapon designed for Johnny Silverhand. Uses a direct cyberinterface that locks the user's cyberarm in place as the weapon fires.

weapons.name: Militech .477 Boomer Buster
weapons.Note: Accuracy is +1 and concealment J with the folding brace deployed or when fired using a cyberarm; otherwise accuracy is -1 and concealment L.

weapons.name: Nomad .44 Magnum Revolver
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nova Arms "Stallone" .357 Plasmatic Magnum
weapons.Note: Plasmatic electrothermal revolver using cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nova Arms "Bronson" .41 Plasmatic Magnum
weapons.Note: Plasmatic electrothermal revolver using cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nova Arms "Eastwood" .44 Plasmatic Magnum
weapons.Note: Plasmatic electrothermal revolver using cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nova Arms "Arno" .454 Plasmatic Magnum
weapons.Note: Plasmatic electrothermal revolver using cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Royal Enfield Ordnance Spitfire 12mm Battle Pistol
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 700eb. Standard ROF is 1; S&S and SAS versions are modified for double-tapping at ROF 2.

weapons.name: Federated Arms Tech-Assault
weapons.Note: Thirty-shot SMG with semi/full-auto rates of fire 10/30.

weapons.name: Federated Arms Tech-Assault II
weapons.Note: Improved light machine pistol derived from the original Tech-Assault.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch MPK-9
weapons.Note: Compact 9mm submachine gun for security and close-protection work.

weapons.name: Militech Mini-Gat Machine Carbine
weapons.Note: Five-barrel electronic Gatling carbine with a 120-round helical magazine and rechargeable magazine battery.

weapons.name: Setsuko-Arasaka "PMS" Sub-Machine Gun
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 1150eb.

weapons.name: Suranam Machine Pistol
weapons.Note: Accepts 25- or 50-round magazines. On a weapon fumble, there is a 75% chance that all remaining rounds cook off, causing 2D6 damage to the firer's arm.

weapons.name: Uzi Miniauto 9
weapons.Note: All-polymer security weapon with a rotary electric magazine and adjustable trigger.

weapons.name: Arasaka WMA "Minami 10"
weapons.Note: An integrally silenced version costs 350eb more and changes accuracy to -1 and concealment to L.

weapons.name: Beretta 1010 Machine Pistol
weapons.Note: Base configuration uses a 30-round magazine. A smaller 15-round magazine can be fitted when the barrel shroud is removed.

weapons.name: Beretta M-24 Advanced Submachine Gun
weapons.Note: Standard Interpol SMG with integral smart link and recoil compensator. Smartchipped price is 1250eb.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch MP-2013
weapons.Note: Modernized MP-5K design with composite construction and integral suppression.

weapons.name: IMI "Gamdaii"
weapons.Note: Dual-feed magazines. Includes a single-shot 25mm/10-gauge launcher: HVY, accuracy 0, capacity 1, ROF 1, ST, range 100m.

weapons.name: Malorian Arms Sub-Flechette Gun
weapons.Note: Fires six penetrators per caseless flechette round. Roll 1D6 penetrator hits; each deals 1D6 damage and treats armor as one-quarter SP.

weapons.name: Militech 10 Submachine Gun
weapons.Note: Damage is 2D6+3 in 10mm or 2D6+2 with the interchangeable .45 ACP caliber kit.

weapons.name: Militech Viper Submachinegun
weapons.Note: Special-operations SMG. The optional suppressor costs 150eb and reduces accuracy by 1.

weapons.name: Mustang Arms ARS-5SC Submachinegun
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 1200eb. Camouflaged version costs 650eb; scope +100eb, laser designator +100eb, silencer +50eb.

weapons.name: Sten
weapons.Note: Approximate price; listed range is 50-100m. Configurations shown in the source include .22 LR (1D6), 9mm Parabellum (2D6+1), .357 Magnum (2D6+3), and 12mm caseless (4D6+1).

weapons.name: Stolbovoy StS Submachinegun
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 1200eb.

weapons.name: CCMMC Tuzi-7
weapons.Note: Finished export model; the source lists the price as 500 yuan, approximately 125eb.

weapons.name: Chadran Arms City Reaper
weapons.Note: Includes an underslung shotgun: SHT, accuracy -1, 4D6 (12 gauge), capacity 10, ROF 3, ST, range 50m.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch MPK-11
weapons.Note: Compact 12mm heavy submachine gun built around the proven MPK action.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch MPK-2020 SMG
weapons.Note: Accuracy includes the integral laser sight.

weapons.name: Ingram MAC 14
weapons.Note: Compact, high-rate heavy submachine gun descended from the classic MAC series.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer SMG-21
weapons.Note: The source lists accuracy as -1 with the folding stock collapsed and 0 with it extended. Supports three-round burst and full-auto rates of 3/15.

weapons.name: Arasaka WCAA "Rapid Assault Shot 12"
weapons.Note: Arasaka selective-fire combat shotgun with single-shot and automatic modes.

weapons.name: CCMMC Qi-15
weapons.Note: The source lists the price as 600 yuan, approximately 150eb. Available only to military police in China.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Hurricane Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Selective-fire assault shotgun with four-round burst and full-auto modes.

weapons.name: Enfield-Ubichi LastChance
weapons.Note: Compact shotgun intended as a powerful last-resort weapon.

weapons.name: Luigi Franchi P.16
weapons.Note: Selective-fire combat shotgun with three-round burst and automatic fire.

weapons.name: Luigi Franchi "King Buck" Multi-Magnum
weapons.Note: The four barrels may be fired individually or all at once. Firing all four at once requires a cyberarm with BOD 11+; otherwise the firer suffers 2D6 damage to the arm.

weapons.name: MetaCorp Warhammer Assault Shotgun
weapons.Note: #00 buckshot deals 4D6+3; HE shells deal 4D6 in a 0.5m radius; dual-purpose penetrator slugs deal 4D6+2 AP, halve armor, and inflict x1.5 damage against unarmored targets.

weapons.name: Military M-12 Close Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Military automatic shotgun with a rotary magazine and ammunition selector. Selecting a different loaded round reduces ROF to 1 for that shot.

weapons.name: Militech Bulldog Compact Assault Shotgun
weapons.Note: Selective-fire 12-gauge combat shotgun with an integral laser pattern indicator. The factory smartgun rig costs 500eb extra.

weapons.name: Militech Crusher SSG
weapons.Note: Accuracy is -1 at 12m and -3 at 25m. Damage is 3D6 at close range and 1D6+2 at medium range; the weapon is ineffective beyond 25m.

weapons.name: Militech Military/Police Shotgun
weapons.Note: The second concealment rating applies with the folding stock folded, changing accuracy to -1. The optional 10-gauge version has no folding stock and deals 5D6 damage.

weapons.name: Mustang Arms Close-Control 20
weapons.Note: Compact 20-gauge bullpup for close quarters, compatible with buckshot, slugs, riot batons, and flechettes.

weapons.name: Mustang Arms "Raider" Riot Shotgun
weapons.Note: Uses a five-round standard magazine or a nine-round extended magazine.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer Stakeout 10
weapons.Note: Light-duty 12-gauge stakeout shotgun used by police and security forces.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms "Ragnarok" Close Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Electrothermal close-assault shotgun with dual reciprocating barrels, hydroshock recoil compensation, and stock-mounted batteries.

weapons.name: AKR-20 Medium Assault
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Arasaka WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Smartchipped and fitted with an integral optical sight. The description also lists a 5-round magazine option.

weapons.name: CCMMC Jinhua M-9
weapons.Note: Listed at 500 yuan, approximately 125eb. Available only in China.

weapons.name: Chadran Arms Jungle Reaper
weapons.Note: Dual-barrel over-under system. The underslung 25mm heavy weapon is HVY, accuracy -2, damage Varies, capacity 6, ROF 2, ST reliability, and 200m range.

weapons.name: Colt M-18 Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Includes a quick-acquisition optical sight granting +1 WA when aiming. Camouflaged finish costs 850eb; smartchipping adds 750eb.

weapons.name: Darra-Polytechnic M-9 Assault Rifle
weapons.Note: Standard configuration is accuracy 0 and concealment N; the side-folding-stock configuration is accuracy -1 and concealment L. Optional hollow-nose ammunition has SP x2 and penetrating damage x1.5; standard ball ammunition deals 4D6. Hollow-nose ammunition costs 45eb per 100 rounds and is available only in the Pacific Rim.

weapons.name: FN-RAL Heavy Assault Rifle
weapons.Note: Accuracy/concealment are -1/N with the stock extended and -2/L with the collapsing stock.

weapons.name: Federated Arms Light Assault 15
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 700eb. Includes smartgun interface plugs and an optical sight. Accuracy becomes +1 when firing a three-round burst.

weapons.name: Fábrica de Armes M-2012
weapons.Note: Base chambering is 6.5x45mm caseless. It can be rebarreled for 6.2x39mm Soviet (5D6+3), 7.62mm NATO (6D6+2), or 7.5mm French Short (6D6+1). Includes a Knipfler & König 2x laser-reflex sight.

weapons.name: Kalashnikov A-80 Heavy Assault Rifle
weapons.Note: Rugged heavy assault rifle descended from the Kalashnikov family.

weapons.name: Militech Dragon Light Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: Compact light assault weapon from Militech's infantry line.

weapons.name: Militech M-31a1 Advanced Infantry Combat Weapon
weapons.Note: Over-under system with an integral 25mm mini-grenade launcher: GL, accuracy -1, concealment -, availability -, damage Varies, capacity 4, ROF 2, ST reliability, and 150m range.

weapons.name: Militech Mk IV Assault Weapon (Revised)
weapons.Note: The quick-change barrel converts the weapon from 6.5mm Hybrid, dealing 6D6-1, to 5.56mm, dealing 5D6.

weapons.name: Militech Ronin Light Assault
weapons.Note: Reliable light assault rifle widely used by corporate and military forces.

weapons.name: Royal Enfield Ordnance Liquid Propellant Assault Rifle LPA1
weapons.Note: Uses two 45-round helical magazines. Velocity settings are Low-riot 2D6+1, Medium-urban 4D6, and High-full combat 6D6. Smartchipped with an integral Marconi SUSAT cyberoptic sight.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer M-95A4 (CG-13B) Assault Weapon
weapons.Note: The listed price range is 695-750eb. Uses a disposable 90-round box magazine and includes a 4x optical sight.

weapons.name: Stolbovoy St-5 Assault Rifle
weapons.Note: Smartchipped version costs 1800eb. Uses cased ammunition. Availability is Common in the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe and Rare in the US and Great Britain.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-20 Advanced Infantry Combat Weapon
weapons.Note: Smartgun system raises WA to +4; the bipod grants +1 WA at Long/Extreme range. Integral 25x50mm mini-grenade launcher: HVY, accuracy 0, concealment -, availability -, damage Varies, capacity 4, ROF 2, ST reliability, and 150m range.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-99 Assault Rifle
weapons.Note: Standard smartgun rig raises WA to +3; the bipod grants +1 WA at Long/Extreme range.

weapons.name: Arasaka WSSA Sniper System
weapons.Note: Smartchipped. Includes a 40-round helical magazine of saboted 3.5mm Frag-Flechettes, silencer, flash suppressor, and Zeiss 12x scope with enhanced laser sighting, night vision, and rangefinding.

weapons.name: Barrett M-90 Sniper Rifle
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition and is useless without a scope. A cyberlinked version costs 2500eb.

weapons.name: Barrett-Arasaka Light-20
weapons.Note: Also known as the Type-13 Heavy Sniper Rifle. The heavy sub-caliber penetrator damages armor for 2 SP per hit.

weapons.name: FR-F6
weapons.Note: Includes a bipod granting +1 WA at Long/Extreme range, computer-assisted laser scope, and sound suppressor.

weapons.name: Nomad 15mm "Long Rifle"
weapons.Note: Requires BOD 9+ to fire from a standing position. Includes scope mount with 10x optical scope, LowLite, muzzle brake, flash hider, solenoid trigger, bipod, and custom furniture; it can be disassembled into three components.

weapons.name: Remington Gyro-Sniper Rifle
weapons.Note: A case of 50 shells costs 400eb. Rocket shells have accuracy 0 at 75m or less. Armor-Piercing Incendiary ammunition deals an extra 1D6 damage for two combat rounds after impact; armor does not stop this extra damage.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-00-Kai
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition for Electrothermal Ammo Enhancement. Smartchipping and computerized sights add +3 WA.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch HK77UK
weapons.Note: Optional equipment includes Militech 25mm mini-auto-stabilizers, SmartGoggles-compatible full-spectrum sight (+600eb), integral suppressor (+200eb), extended magazine (+60eb), and a folding 45mm U-drum (+600eb). Folding the stock improves concealment from L to J, but firing while folded reduces WA to -1.

weapons.name: Hughes Rocket Rifle
weapons.Note: Uses shaped-charge rocket ammunition. Penetrating damage is not halved. Ammunition costs 20eb per round.

weapons.name: M-99 EVAW
weapons.Note: Dual-barrel EVA weapon. The secondary 25mm system is HVY, WA 0, damage 2D6+1 HE, capacity 10, ROF 1, ST reliability, 10m minimum range, and 2000m effective range. 25mm grenade rounds cost 50eb; rocket rounds cost 125eb.

weapons.name: Militech Cyborg Rifle
weapons.Note: Designed for borg fighting and drop-fire use. Standard and armor-piercing ammunition are available; the weapon weighs 7.5kg.

weapons.name: Militech Ninja
weapons.Note: Caseless design with an integral silencer.

weapons.name: Nomad .357 Magnum Automatic Carbine
weapons.Note: WA is +1 when fired single-shot at ROF 2; it can alternatively fire a three-round burst at ROF 3. Standard hot loads deal 3D6+1. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nomad .357 Magnum Lever-Action Carbine
weapons.Note: Tube-fed lever-action rifle using cased ammunition. Standard hot loads deal 3D6+1.

weapons.name: Nomad .44 Magnum Lever-Action Rifle
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nomad 7.62mm Bolt-Action Rifle
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Nomad "Personal Weapon" Derivatives
weapons.Note: Current derivatives usually fire 10mm caseless ammunition for 2D6+3 or 12mm caseless ammunition for 4D6+1; older versions use 5.7mm cased rounds for 3D6. The design may be treated as either a heavy SMG or an assault rifle.

weapons.name: Polymer One-Shot Cannon
weapons.Note: Disposable weapon. Damage is half real and half stun-only; armor has no effect and is damaged by two levels. On a jam the weapon breaks, with a 10% chance of exploding for 2D6 damage to the firer's arm.

weapons.name: Stein & Wasserman Model F "Cyborg Assault" Weapon System
weapons.Note: Uses cased ammunition and a rotary-feed magazine that can mix ammunition types. HEP deals 4D6+2, half real and half stun-only, ignores armor, and damages armor by two levels. API incendiary deals 4D6+3, halves armor SP, then deals an extra 1D6 on the next round and 2D6 on the following round; armor does not stop the extra damage. Acid shells use the listed chemical-shell effects.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms Ramjet Rifle
weapons.Note: Damage is 5D6+3 at Close range, 6D6+1 at Medium range, 7D6 at Long range, and 7D6+3 at Extreme range. Armor SP is tripled, while penetrating damage is doubled.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Cyclone Squad Support Weapon
weapons.Note: Includes recoil suppression, carrying sling, and bipod.

weapons.name: Constitution Arms Deluge Crowd Control Weapon
weapons.Note: Non-lethal crowd-control weapon. The magazine contains 400 sleep darts and a compressed-air canister.

weapons.name: Dover GA-1112 Autogun
weapons.Note: Double-barreled area-suppression weapon with an integral smartgun rig. A 650eb vehicle-mounting kit adds a swivel clamp, 1200-round ammunition tank, and direct motor-power feed.

weapons.name: FN MG-6 "One-on-One"
weapons.Note: Heavy squad-support weapon designed to dominate a single firing lane.

weapons.name: Fábrica de Armes M-2012HB SAW
weapons.Note: Specialized automatic version of the M-2012 with a 10x scope and 31-inch barrel.

weapons.name: Heckler & Koch G-6 Advanced Squad Automatic
weapons.Note: Squad-support derivative of the G-11 system with a 100-round magazine and integral optics.

weapons.name: M2A5HB Browning .50cal HMG
weapons.Note: Modernized heavy Browning machine gun using .50-caliber cased ammunition.

weapons.name: M-60D Medium Machine Gun
weapons.Note: Vehicle and door-gun variant of the classic M-60 medium machine gun.

weapons.name: Militech High Power 15
weapons.Note: Tripod-mounted high-speed support weapon. The listed firing rates are 20 and 60.

weapons.name: Militech M-232 Squad Assault/Automatic Weapon
weapons.Note: Accepts a 100-round disintegrating belt from a drum or a standard 35-round Mk IV magazine.

weapons.name: Militech Renegade Squad Automatic Weapon
weapons.Note: Accepts a 200-round disintegrating belt or 35-round magazines from the Dragon and Mk IV assault weapons.

weapons.name: Militech 20L Autocannon
weapons.Note: Tripod-mounted crew-served autocannon. Uses cased ammunition.

weapons.name: Sternmeyer M-5A Squad Automatic Weapon
weapons.Note: European squad automatic weapon built for sustained infantry support fire.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-8 Medium Machine Gun
weapons.Note: A 100-round backpack ammunition pack is also available.

weapons.name: 60mm Light Mortar
weapons.Note: Crew-served mortar with a 5m burst radius. It normally requires two operators; with only one operator, ROF falls to one shot per two combat turns. HE shells cost 50eb and weigh 1kg each. Smoke, illumination, and white-phosphorus rounds are also available.

weapons.name: Rheinmetall-Mauser MEX Cannon
weapons.Note: Semi-automatic shoulder-fired cannon with a 4x telescopic sight. A BOD 15+ roll is required to avoid 1-2 points of bruise damage to the firing arm or shoulder. A critical failure causes the firer to drop the weapon.

weapons.name: Commercial Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Generic single-shot grenade launcher. It may be mounted beneath an assault rifle or fitted with a simple shoulder stock for separate use.

weapons.name: Kenshiri-Adachi F-253 Flamethrower
weapons.Note: Back-mounted liquefied-napalm flamethrower.

weapons.name: LAW
weapons.Note: Disposable light anti-tank weapon with a 2m burst radius. Uses a recoilless, non-backblast launch system and is safe to fire indoors.

weapons.name: HLAW
weapons.Note: Disposable heavy light anti-tank weapon with a 4m burst radius. Uses a recoilless, non-backblast launch system and is safe to fire indoors.

weapons.name: M-32 Automatic Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Tripod- or vehicle-mounted automatic grenade launcher. It normally uses high-velocity 40mm ammunition. Standard 40mm grenades may be used only in single-shot mode.

weapons.name: M-205 Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Single-shot breech-loading grenade launcher usable independently or as an under-barrel weapon.

weapons.name: M-212 Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Break-action grenade launcher with an eight-round revolving cylinder. The firer may select which loaded grenade type is brought into the chamber.

weapons.name: Militech AM-3 "Anti-Matter Rifle"
weapons.Note: Rocket-boosted depleted-uranium rifle. From 0-160m, accuracy is 0 and damage is one-third; from 160-800m, accuracy is +1 and damage is one-half; from 800-1600m, accuracy is 0 and damage is full. Requires BOD 15+ to avoid 1-3 bruise damage unless used with a linear frame or Beta-or-better body. Includes a cyberoptic smartgun interlock and 2-10x low-light/thermal scope. Ammunition costs 100eb per round.

weapons.name: Militech "Cowboy" U-55 Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Semi-automatic launcher capable of three-shot bursts. It may mix ammunition types in its rotary drum and includes an integral optical sight. Fragmentation, flash, incendiary, concussion, gas, and smoke loads cost 30eb per round.

weapons.name: Militech Hotshot L-ATGM
weapons.Note: Wire-guided anti-tank missile with a 4m burst radius. It is normally thermograph-equipped, but may be laser-guided or fitted with optical guidance. Each missile costs 1500eb.

weapons.name: Militech Mini-Grenade Launcher (Pump Model)
weapons.Note: Pump-action mini-grenade launcher. It may also use 10-gauge shotgun ammunition. ROF falls to 1 when changing between loaded ammunition types. Mini-grenade ammunition costs 30eb per round.

weapons.name: Militech Mini-Grenade Launcher (Drum Model)
weapons.Note: Rotary-drum mini-grenade launcher built on a modified Militech 10 frame. The shooter may select among different loaded ammunition types. It may also use 10-gauge shotgun ammunition. ROF falls to 1 when changing ammunition types. Mini-grenade ammunition costs 30eb per round.

weapons.name: Militech RPG-A Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Shoulder-fired rocket-powered grenade launcher widely used in the Central American conflicts.

weapons.name: Militech Scorpion 16 Surface-To-Air Missile
weapons.Note: Heat-seeking active surface-to-air missile with a 6m burst radius, digital-memory guidance backups, and fire-and-forget tracking after target lock.

weapons.name: Militech Urban Missile Launcher
weapons.Note: Magazine-fed shoulder launcher firing self-guided, heat-seeking, explosive MicroMissiles.

weapons.name: Under-Barrel MicroMissile Pod
weapons.Note: Muzzle-loading one-shot pod mounted beneath a shoulder arm. Initial installation costs an additional 50eb.

weapons.name: Rheinmetall EMG-85 Railgun
weapons.Note: ROF is one shot every two combat rounds. Extra-AP effect reduces armor to one-quarter SP and penetrating damage to one-half. Minimum BOD 11 is required with a linear frame or ACPA. The gyrostabilized mount-harness avoids the MA penalty but has EV 1; firing without it requires BOD 12 and a smartgun link, with -1 MA and EV 2. Power charging costs 700eb.

weapons.name: Rostovic Wrist Racate
weapons.Note: Cylindrical wrist-mounted rocket pod firing single rockets or volleys. It must be worn over a cyberarm or battleglove. Rockets are sold in packs of six for 200eb.

weapons.name: Royal Enfield Ordnance 25mm Cockerill Assault Cannon
weapons.Note: Low-pressure rocket-assisted assault cannon. Firing from the hip is possible but not recommended and imposes WA -1. BOD 8+ may fire it from the hip; otherwise the bipod is required. BOD 6+ is required to carry and use it. Available ammunition includes AP, HEP, and APF anti-personnel flechette. HEP deals half real and half stun damage, ignores armor, and removes 2 SP. APF is treated as a shotgun round with a maximum range of 100m.

weapons.name: Towa Manufacturing Type-9 Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Revolver-cylinder grenade launcher allowing the firer to select among loaded grenade types.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms Type-17 Anti-Armor Rifle
weapons.Note: Japanese anti-ACPA and anti-vehicle rifle using cased ammunition. Includes a bipod granting +1 WA at Long/Extreme range, computerized sights, and a smartgun rig raising WA to +3. The firer suffers 1 Stun damage per shot. BOD 14 or an equivalent linear frame/full-borg body is required to fire without the bipod and brace.

weapons.name: Tsunami Arms Type-18 Automatic Grenade Launcher
weapons.Note: Bazooka-like automatic grenade launcher connected to a 25kg backpack magazine. Changing the magazine requires at least four actions. Its gyro-balancer and recoil compensation do not prevent a -1 REF and -1 MA penalty from its weight and bulk.

title: Weapons
description: Firearms and basic ammunition restored from Blackhand's Street Weapons 2020; the site's established catalog scope is preserved.
